messages:
sara: FYI — enterprise pilot (FinCo) signed LOE. They want SSO + tenant quotas + usage auditing. Our bandwidth is tight this quarter.

lee: options: (A) narrow MVP to SAML + manual quota enforcement (ops-run), (B) delay pilot 3w to include automated quotas + audit.

nina: engineering estimate: SAML 1w, quotas + audit automation ~3w.

raj: customer success: FinCo will run pilot only if quotas are demonstrable; manual enforcement might be ok if we provide tracked SLAs.

al: ops can support manual quota enforcement for up to 2 pilots if we supply a runbook and dashboard.

sara: risks: if we promise automation and miss, we lose them. proposal: SAML-only pilot + ops-assisted quotas, commit to automation by v1. pilot start in 2w, v1 GA +7w.

lee: +1. we'll add a launch gate: "automation OR documented manual workflow accepted by customer".

nina: dev plan: prioritize SAML this sprint, feature-flag quota checks off for pilot, backlog SCOPED tasks for v1 automation.

raj: i'll confirm with FinCo that manual enforcement is acceptable and lock their success metrics.

al: i'll draft runbook and schedule oncall for first 3 weeks.

calendar-bot: "Event created: FinCo pilot scope review Thursday 09:30"

sara: actions: raj update FinCo today; al publish runbook in 48h; nina update PRD by EOD. marking resolved unless customer insists on automation before pilot. :white_check_mark:
